---
id: tuatara
title: Tuatara
---
The tuatara (*Sphenodon punctatus*) is not a lizard: it is the last
rhynchocephalian, surviving on New Zealand islands. A parietal eye sits
under skin on the skull. Growth is slow; animals may live many decades.
They forage at cool night temperatures that would stall most lizards.
Rats on the mainland nearly erased them; sanctuary islands hold the
remainder.
